# DemandMatch

> DemandMatch matches your inventory with your customers' demand, automatically. Software for distributors of chemicals, plastics and industrial goods: more sales, better margin, and your sales team only approves.

DemandMatch is sales software for B2B distributors of chemicals, plastics and industrial goods, founded in Berlin by Bing Cai and Richard von Waldow.
It reads the systems a distributor already runs (ERP such as SAP, Oracle, Odoo or DATEV; CRM such as HubSpot; the inbox; messengers) read-only, and matches inventory with customer demand in both directions:

- Demand finds stock: for every request from email, phone or CRM it finds the right material, warehouse and margin and prepares the offer.
- Stock finds demand: for overstock and inbound goods it finds the customers who buy exactly that and prepares a personal message for each.

A person in sales approves everything before it goes out. Companies start with a free fit check, then a value assessment and a 30-day pilot on their real data. Contact: hello@demandmatch.io.

## Pricing

All prices net (excl. VAT in Europe, excl. sales tax in the US). Every paid step is credited in full to the next one.

- Fit check (30 minutes): Free
- Value assessment (3 weeks): €20,000 / $25,000
- Pilot (30 days): €60,000 / $65,000
- Annual license, by revenue in scope (like tax brackets, each rate counts only for the revenue inside its band): Up to €1bn: €45,000 per €100m; €1bn to €3bn: €20,000 per €100m; Above €3bn: €10,000 per €100m; Minimum license: €180,000 per year. In US dollars the same rates per $100m, minimum $200,000 per year.
- Onboarding: 30% of the annual license, at least €60,000 / $65,000; included in a 3-year term, charged in year one on a 1-year term.
- Every license includes every feature, for every customer: matching both ways, offers with margin, freight and your pricing rules, read-only connection to ERP, CRM and inbox, several ERP systems, single sign-on and unlimited sales users (fair use). How complex your system landscape is goes into onboarding, not the license. Nothing goes out without your team's approval.
- Paid annually in advance, 12-month minimum term. The value assessment and the pilot are credited in full.
- Business case calculator: https://demandmatch.io/en/#roi
